overview: Saint-Hyacinthe counted 57,239 residents in the 2021 Census, up 2.9 percent from 2016. They live in 26,870 occupied dwellings across 188.85 square kilometres, where the historic downtown is ringed by residential districts, industrial parks and some of Quebec's richest farmland.

Agri-food defines the economy, from food processors and research centres to the veterinary faculty and agricultural college. For a local business, that means a specialized workforce, steady business-to-business demand from food companies and farms, and a mature resident base that values established local providers.
